Consider the costs and consequences of acting.

sections.heading: About this website
sections.text: This website introduces Timothy Madu and the Business Playbook Series. This initial policy describes the features included in this version. The publisher must review and update it before a public launch or any change to data collection.

sections.heading: Browsing and search
sections.text: Catalogue search runs in your browser. This site does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts or a mailing list. The hosting provider may process technical request information, including IP addresses, for operation and security. If the site is private, ChatGPT sign-in and access are managed by the hosting provider.

sections.heading: Contact enquiries
sections.text: The contact form is disabled until delivery and spam protection are configured. When enabled, it collects your name, email address and message to respond to your enquiry. Cloudflare Turnstile processes a security challenge and Resend delivers the message to the publisher. Do not submit payment details or sensitive personal information.

sections.heading: Storage and retention
sections.text: Messages are not stored in the website catalogue or content files. Delivered messages are retained in the publisher’s configured inbox and may appear in the mail provider’s delivery logs. The publisher must set and disclose a retention period, a privacy contact and any other required disclosures before enabling the form.

sections.heading: Third-party links
sections.text: Purchase buttons, when configured, take you to an external seller. That service handles its own payments, delivery and privacy practices. No payment details are collected by this website.

sections.heading: Your enquiries
sections.text: A public privacy contact has not yet been supplied. Privacy enquiries and applicable rights requests should use the publisher’s contact details once added. This policy needs final publisher review before public launch.

sections.heading: Use of this website
sections.text: This website provides information about the Business Playbook Series and related educational resources. Its content is general business information and does not replace advice suited to your circumstances.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.text: Book descriptions, original resources and other publisher content are protected by applicable intellectual property law. Free resources may be downloaded for your own use; permission is required for resale or redistribution unless a resource states otherwise.

sections.heading: External purchases
sections.text: External sellers set and administer their own prices, availability, delivery, refunds and transaction terms. Review those terms before purchasing. The website does not process payments.

sections.heading: Accuracy and availability
sections.text: The publisher aims to keep information accurate but may update descriptions, links and availability. Nothing on this website guarantees a financial or business result.

books.title: The Customer Friction Playbook
books.subtitle: A Practical System for Finding, Prioritising and Fixing the Barriers That Stop Customers From Buying, Staying and Returning
books.coverAlt: Typographic website edition of The Customer Friction Playbook cover
books.shortDescription: Find where effort, uncertainty or delay gets in the way of your customers, then decide which barriers deserve attention first.
description: Every customer journey involves a sequence of decisions and actions. This playbook focuses on understanding where those actions become unnecessarily difficult and what a business can do about it.
Work through a structured improvement sequence: MAP, DETECT, DIAGNOSE, PRIORITISE, REDESIGN and MEASURE. Keep the focus on the cause of a problem and the evidence needed to assess the result.
books.author: Timothy Madu
takeaways: Map the steps customers need to take.
Investigate the causes of friction before choosing a fix.
Prioritise improvements and check what changes achieve.

books.metaDescription: Explore Timothy Madu’s practical system for finding, prioritising and fixing barriers that stop customers buying, staying and returning.

books.title: The Missed Revenue Playbook
books.subtitle: How to Find, Evaluate and Recover Revenue Your Business Is Already Positioned to Capture
books.coverAlt: Typographic website edition of The Missed Revenue Playbook cover
books.shortDescription: Examine opportunities within your existing business and evaluate what may be recoverable, what it would cost to act and what evidence would demonstrate a worthwhile result.
description: Revenue opportunities deserve careful evaluation. This playbook explores how to examine opportunities a business may already be positioned to capture, while considering costs, operational demands and customer impact.
An opportunity estimate is not a verified result. Keep baseline performance, attribution, incremental effect and contribution in view when assessing what an improvement actually achieves.
books.author: Timothy Madu
takeaways: Identify opportunities within the existing business.
Evaluate likely benefits alongside cost and feasibility.
Distinguish estimates from observed, attributable results.

resources.title: Four questions before you change a business process
resources.summary: A short reflection for turning a business observation into an investigation.
resources.author: Timothy Madu
body: What did you actually observe? Describe the specific event or repeated pattern. Separate what you saw from your explanation of why it happened.
Who experienced the problem, and at which step? Place the observation in a customer or operational journey. Avoid assuming every customer has the same experience.
What evidence could challenge your explanation? Look for exceptions, alternative causes and missing information before choosing a solution.
How would you check the effect of a change? Decide what to measure, over what period and against which baseline. Consider cost and unintended consequences alongside the intended benefit.
resources.seoTitle: Four questions before changing a business process
resources.metaDescription: A practical business reflection on observation, causes, evidence and measuring the effect of a change.
